pages.title: Tabbyrium Blossom
pages.text: Crafted on a Crafting Table using $(2)4 Trinitite$(0), $(6)2 Overdrive Powder$(0), $(c)Redstone Dust$(0), and any $(a)Sapling$(0).$(br2)When grown, it sprouts a 3–5 block tall stalk that extends root tendrils across the terrain (capped at ~18 crust blocks). Its crown $(a)Spore Pod$(0) actively nurtures pulsing crystal clusters along these veins.

pages.title: Radiation & Wither
pages.text: $(c)BIOLOGICAL HAZARD:$(0)$(br)Tabbyrium fields leach organic matter. Stepping onto $(8)Tabbyrium Crust$(0) or brush against $(a)Tabbyrium Clusters$(0) will violently afflict you with $(4)Wither$(0) and lacerations.$(br2)Harvest clusters at stage 3 using a pickaxe for maximum shard yield.

pages.title: Tabbyrium Refinery
pages.text: Process $(a)Tabbyrium Shards$(0) (10,000 FE) or dense $(a)Crystals$(0) (45,000 FE) inside the $(2)Tabbyrium Refinery$(0).$(br2)Features automated I/O configuration sides and an internal power buffer to pump energy directly into neighboring conduits or Silos.

pages.title: Tabbyrium Silos
pages.text: Crafted from Iron Blocks, Copper Blocks, and a core block of $(2)Trinitite$(0).$(br2)Stores $(6)1,000,000 FE$(0) with live exterior fluid gauges. Right-click opens the Command Console with an integrated $(a)Induction Charging Slot$(0) to charge held gear and Portable Cat Chargers at 10,000 FE/t! If capacity maxes out, tactical $(c)EVA 'SILOS NEEDED'$(0) alarms sound.
